notes.title: Ordinary Patch (1.0.2.0)
notes.content:
In this ordinary update;

Added

 New dialog to mailboxes
 Added ability to close fridge
 Added clear text option to make font readable


Changed

 Changed credits font to be readable


Fixed

 Fixed player getting angry at mailboxes
 Fixed bobbing still active when interacting
 Fixed joe not working after stage 1

A small patch, can you find the little secrets hidden in it?

Changes

 When completing the game the main menu will be different (requested by BarryTheBlue)
 Secrets, more secrets.


Fixed

 Fixed vase only being interactable in specific stages
 Fixed bin allowing you to break out the map

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Verify your game files if you have not already had an update to your game! This will update your game with the release build and intended version.

notes.title: A quick update on development!
notes.content:
How's it going?
Well, the longest part has been the catacombs from the expansion, NekOz has been working on it on/off for a while and he's finally considered it complete enough to move on to the next segment, the remaining segments are in their blockout phase and hopefully will be much quicker to complete.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379647/ac43ce1382b414162b562e3ede7a64ea22b154f3.png


Of course, what you see may change! Oz did a great job on the church exterior too, this is still under work so keep that in mind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379647/422f5dc5bc41b2c96f57fc87ac7a1e4cf330515f.png

Hope you like the little lantern sway, feels pretty good! The hands do move too, makes it a little less static.
[previewyoutube=bQx5Ukv8iKI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope this was a nice little update, we're excited to release OD however we still have some work to do till then, consider sharing this around, your support helps a lot, thank you to all who have wishlisted OD!
